municipalPreviewCheck.decision: Rejected as a height reference: this simplified legacy component does not represent the visible tower or complete roof.

interpretation: Retains original mapped cruciform outline. Ochre walls, pale trim, curved copper roofs, octagonal crossing drum/dome, staged bell tower, four geometric clock faces, square flared spire, ball/cross, columned portico and stairs are original geometry. Fine relief, rear/side details, exact roof curvature, window placement, fence and landscaping remain provisional.
